all_facts.Wine description:
Rich, silky and complex, Ornellaia Bolgheri Superiore is a red wine made from Petit Verdot in the foothills of the Mediterranean coast, Bolgheri, Italy. Expect silky tannins, bold, oaky notes of tobacco and chocolate, black fruit notes of blackberry and plum and deep, earthy flavors of leather and smoke that come together to create a complex flavor profile.

Perfect for sharing with friends at a dinner party, Ornellaia Bolgheri Superiore pairs beautifully with hearty dishes that include beef, lamb, game and veal, alongside rich, delicious pastas. Pop open and enjoy a compilation of indulgent flavors.

Ornellaia winery is located in Bolgheri, a wine region renowned for its ‘super Tuscan’ wines that include cabernet sauvignon, cabernet franc and syrah. Super Tuscan wines are typically characterized by their ripe berry flavors, firm tannins and lasting finishes, which can definitely be said for Bolgheri Superiore.

For reviews, prices and vintages of this delicious red wine, trust in Vivino.

wine_name: Antinori Badia a Passignano Gran Selezione Chianti Classico 2020

all_facts.Wine description: Marchesi Antinori’s passion for viticulture is expressed through perseverance: their continuous pursuit for quality improvement, even in the smallest details. Research and development is an ongoing process both in the vineyards and in the cellars: selecting new clones of local and international varieties: experimenting with new techniques in the vineyards and vineyard altitudes, new approaches to fermentation and temperature control, experimenting with both traditional and innovative winemaking philosophies, using new types of oak for barrels, barrel size and age, and varying length of aging in the bottle before commercial release. To succeed at best expressing what a vineyard, grape, and a winemaker can achieve requires constant trial and error, both in the vineyard and in the winery. At Marchesi Antinori, these experiments include a wide range of different grape varieties and clones, planted in a variety of vineyards, different styles and sizes of fermentors as well as techniques of fermentation; barrel types and sizes; length of barrel and bottle aging.

wine_name: La Ferme du Mont Côtes Capelan Châteauneuf-du-Pape 2009

all_facts.Wine description:
Bold, full-bodied and slightly dry, Châteauneuf-du-Pape wine is preceded by a huge reputation, and for good reason, too. Acclaimed as 'a southern Rhône Valley masterpiece' by the Vivino community, every sip will transport you to the distinctive Mediterranean climate of this wine's origin.

Given its Rhône Valley roots, La Ferme du Mont Côtes Capelan Châteauneuf-du-Pape was destined for excellence starting from the very first grape harvest, thanks to a blend of advantageous geographic, climatic and geological elements. With distinctive earthy, oaky and black fruit notes La Ferme du Mont Côtes Capelan Châteauneuf-du-Pape’s unmistakable flavor pairs well with lamb, pork and poultry, making it a firm favorite with hosts across the U.S.

Blending opulence with class, this exceptional wine boasts a remarkably prolonged and vibrant finish, presenting flavors of velvety black raspberry and cherry compote that are a delight to the palate, complemented by subtle notes of spice and cola in the latter part. Whether pairing with a hearty meat dinner, or buying as a gift wine, Châteauneuf-du-Pape is certain to be well-received and enjoyed by all.

all_facts.Wine description: Truly exceptional wine made by passionate people encapsulates our success story both in New Zealand and around the world. Villa Maria wines are sourced from Auckland, Gisborne, Hawkes Bay and the world-famous Marlborough region, offering incredible diversity in terroir and suitability for different grape varieties. Globally Villa Maria is best known for Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc, however we produce extraordinary Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Pinot Gris, Rosé, Bordeaux style red varietals and Syrah (amongst others) which are all highly awarded and regarded as some of New Zealand’s most iconic fine wines. Villa Maria was the first company in New Zealand to employ professional viticulturists, recognising the part viticulture plays in the quality of the wine. Our vineyard managers understand how to get the best from our vines and soils, and have an in-depth viticulture knowledge of how to make our vineyards robust and resilient – by doing the right things at the right time to ensure the vines are not put under unnecessary stress. The result is consistently superb quality across a range of wines for any occasion.

all_facts.Wine description:
Rich, silky and complex, Ornellaia Bolgheri Superiore is a red wine made from Petit Verdot in the foothills of the Mediterranean coast, Bolgheri, Italy. Expect silky tannins, bold, oaky notes of tobacco and chocolate, black fruit notes of blackberry and plum and deep, earthy flavors of leather and smoke that come together to create a complex flavor profile.

Perfect for sharing with friends at a dinner party, Ornellaia Bolgheri Superiore pairs beautifully with hearty dishes that include beef, lamb, game and veal, alongside rich, delicious pastas. Pop open and enjoy a compilation of indulgent flavors.

Ornellaia winery is located in Bolgheri, a wine region renowned for its ‘super Tuscan’ wines that include cabernet sauvignon, cabernet franc and syrah. Super Tuscan wines are typically characterized by their ripe berry flavors, firm tannins and lasting finishes, which can definitely be said for Bolgheri Superiore.

For reviews, prices and vintages of this delicious red wine, trust in Vivino.

all_facts.Wine description:
Full bodied and smooth on the palette, Casa Vinicola Bennati Amarone della Valpolicella is the perfect easy drinking wine to enjoy over a catch up with friends. Revel in its rich, oaky notes of vanilla, tobacco and chocolate, balanced with black fruit notes of plum and cherry reminiscent of its ruby red hue.

Featured in the top 25 of Italian wines in California right now, Casa Vinicola Bennati Amarone is recommended by our community to be enjoyed alongside rich dishes that match its deep flavor profile such as beef, lamb, game and strong blue cheese. However, it’s an excellent wine to savor on its own, take in all of the notes it has to offer and enjoy its long finish.

Casa Vinicola Bennati Amarone is a dry Italian red wine from the renowned wine region of Veneto, Northern Italy. Known for its bold and ripe flavors, you can explore its vintages throughout the years, read reviews from our knowledgeable community and explore pricing here at Vivino.

all_facts.Wine description:
The heart of Stag’s Leap Wine Cellars is undoubtedly the estate vineyards and extraordinary care is taken to assure that a wine’s aroma, flavor, and texture convey a sense of place. As the difference between a good wine and a great one is often in the details, our viticultural practices are driven by extreme, even obsessive, attention to detail. Throughout the growing season and all the way through harvest, vines are cared for to achieve their optimum maturity level and ensure the ‘signature’ of the terroir is expressed to its fullest.

The goal is to create wines of classic beauty — wines with balance, complexity and harmony.

From the beginning, the Stag’s Leap Wine Cellars vision has been to create wines that speak to the place from which they come. These goals are realized in our three limited-production Estate-Grown Cabernet Sauvignons – CASK 23, S.L.V. and FAY—which are crafted from vineyards surrounding the winery.

The same classic style of the Estate wines is also expressed in the Napa Valley Collection, which consists of three wines: AVETA Sauvignon Blanc; KARIA Chardonnay and ARTEMIS Cabernet Sauvignon.

wine_name: Ricasoli Castello di Brolio Vin Santo del Chianti Classico 2008

all_facts.Wine description:
The Castello di Brolio Vin Santo, true to tradition, expresses one of the "historic" grapes of the area, Malvasia del Chianti. Its production method also stays true to tradition.
The grapes destined for Vin Santo are gathered late in the harvest, at the point at which the sugar content is high enough to sustain the long ageing process that this wine undergoes. The bunches are hung and left to dry partially for several months. The must obtained from light crushing ferments slowly and is then placed in 225-litre half-barriques of oak.

all_facts.Wine description:
The heart of Stag’s Leap Wine Cellars is undoubtedly the estate vineyards and extraordinary care is taken to assure that a wine’s aroma, flavor, and texture convey a sense of place. As the difference between a good wine and a great one is often in the details, our viticultural practices are driven by extreme, even obsessive, attention to detail. Throughout the growing season and all the way through harvest, vines are cared for to achieve their optimum maturity level and ensure the ‘signature’ of the terroir is expressed to its fullest.

The goal is to create wines of classic beauty — wines with balance, complexity and harmony.

From the beginning, the Stag’s Leap Wine Cellars vision has been to create wines that speak to the place from which they come. These goals are realized in our three limited-production Estate-Grown Cabernet Sauvignons – CASK 23, S.L.V. and FAY—which are crafted from vineyards surrounding the winery.

The same classic style of the Estate wines is also expressed in the Napa Valley Collection, which consists of three wines: AVETA Sauvignon Blanc; KARIA Chardonnay and ARTEMIS Cabernet Sauvignon.

Belle Glos Clark & Telephone Pinot Noir is a dry red wine from the Santa Maria Wine Valley in California, known for its complexity of flavors and mild, velvety tannins. With every glass, you can expect deep oaky notes of chocolate and tobacco that are perfectly balanced with hints of cherry, blackberry and spices.

This wine pairs perfectly with beef, veal, game, deer and poultry, so it’s great for pairing with rich, meaty dishes. Although according to some of our community, it also pairs well with lighter snacks such as almonds or olives, or in place of a dessert after dinner thanks to its fruity nose.
This bottle from Belle Glos Winery is widely loved by the Vivino community, with its 2018 vintage coming in third out of all Californian Pinot Noir wines in the United States.

At Vivino, we’re passionate about helping our community choose the right wine for them. Find out more about Belle Glos Clark & Telephone Pinot Noir, including pricing, vintages and reviews below.

all_facts.Wine description: Truly exceptional wine made by passionate people encapsulates our success story both in New Zealand and around the world. Villa Maria wines are sourced from Auckland, Gisborne, Hawkes Bay and the world-famous Marlborough region, offering incredible diversity in terroir and suitability for different grape varieties. Globally Villa Maria is best known for Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc, however we produce extraordinary Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Pinot Gris, Rosé, Bordeaux style red varietals and Syrah (amongst others) which are all highly awarded and regarded as some of New Zealand’s most iconic fine wines. Villa Maria was the first company in New Zealand to employ professional viticulturists, recognising the part viticulture plays in the quality of the wine. Our vineyard managers understand how to get the best from our vines and soils, and have an in-depth viticulture knowledge of how to make our vineyards robust and resilient – by doing the right things at the right time to ensure the vines are not put under unnecessary stress. The result is consistently superb quality across a range of wines for any occasion.

all_facts.Wine description:
The 2010 vintage of Bougainville is 85% Petite Sirah and 15% Syrah. The roundness and
sweetness of the latter complements the verticality of the former to completely fill the
palate. The nose shows tremendous elegance, with lively aromas of black fruits in
balance with sweet spices as well as nuances of earth and smoke mixed with the
balsamic notes that are characteristic of Maipo. On the palate, an initial friendly
sweetness leads to juicy acidity, and smoky notes, chocolate, and spice appear on the
long finish. It is still a very young wine, but the great structure of soft, ripe tannins as
well as the bright acidity reveal a long life ahead during which time the charmingly
rustic tannins will become smoothly polished.

all_facts.Wine description:
Erath wines are crafted from a wide variety of vineyards in the Willamette and Umpqua Valleys and the Dundee Hills Appellations. Each vineyard is unique in climate, elevation and soil structure. Key vineyard sources in the Dundee Hills include Prince Hill, Niederberger, and Knight’s Gambit vineyards. The volcanic-based, red Jory soils are predominate in these growing areas and give the wines their distinctive aroma and flavor profiles, and elegant, age-worthy structure that define Pinot Noir from Oregon.
Sourcing from a diverse range of vineyard sites allows winemaker Gary Horner to craft the perfect blend. He strongly believes in building and maintaining long term relationships with growers to further guarantee optimal quality year in and year out.

all_facts.Wine description:
Rich, silky and complex, Ornellaia Bolgheri Superiore is a red wine made from Petit Verdot in the foothills of the Mediterranean coast, Bolgheri, Italy. Expect silky tannins, bold, oaky notes of tobacco and chocolate, black fruit notes of blackberry and plum and deep, earthy flavors of leather and smoke that come together to create a complex flavor profile.

Perfect for sharing with friends at a dinner party, Ornellaia Bolgheri Superiore pairs beautifully with hearty dishes that include beef, lamb, game and veal, alongside rich, delicious pastas. Pop open and enjoy a compilation of indulgent flavors.

Ornellaia winery is located in Bolgheri, a wine region renowned for its ‘super Tuscan’ wines that include cabernet sauvignon, cabernet franc and syrah. Super Tuscan wines are typically characterized by their ripe berry flavors, firm tannins and lasting finishes, which can definitely be said for Bolgheri Superiore.

For reviews, prices and vintages of this delicious red wine, trust in Vivino.

all_facts.Wine description:
The heart of Stag’s Leap Wine Cellars is undoubtedly the estate vineyards and extraordinary care is taken to assure that a wine’s aroma, flavor, and texture convey a sense of place. As the difference between a good wine and a great one is often in the details, our viticultural practices are driven by extreme, even obsessive, attention to detail. Throughout the growing season and all the way through harvest, vines are cared for to achieve their optimum maturity level and ensure the ‘signature’ of the terroir is expressed to its fullest.

The goal is to create wines of classic beauty — wines with balance, complexity and harmony.

From the beginning, the Stag’s Leap Wine Cellars vision has been to create wines that speak to the place from which they come. These goals are realized in our three limited-production Estate-Grown Cabernet Sauvignons – CASK 23, S.L.V. and FAY—which are crafted from vineyards surrounding the winery.

The same classic style of the Estate wines is also expressed in the Napa Valley Collection, which consists of three wines: AVETA Sauvignon Blanc; KARIA Chardonnay and ARTEMIS Cabernet Sauvignon.

wine_name: Villa Maria Private Bin Sauvignon Blanc 2022

all_facts.Allergens: Contains sulfites, egg allergens, milk allergens
all_facts.Wine description: Truly exceptional wine made by passionate people encapsulates our success story both in New Zealand and around the world. Villa Maria wines are sourced from Auckland, Gisborne, Hawkes Bay and the world-famous Marlborough region, offering incredible diversity in terroir and suitability for different grape varieties. Globally Villa Maria is best known for Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc, however we produce extraordinary Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Pinot Gris, Rosé, Bordeaux style red varietals and Syrah (amongst others) which are all highly awarded and regarded as some of New Zealand’s most iconic fine wines. Villa Maria was the first company in New Zealand to employ professional viticulturists, recognising the part viticulture plays in the quality of the wine. Our vineyard managers understand how to get the best from our vines and soils, and have an in-depth viticulture knowledge of how to make our vineyards robust and resilient – by doing the right things at the right time to ensure the vines are not put under unnecessary stress. The result is consistently superb quality across a range of wines for any occasion.

wine_name: Villa Maria Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon - Merlot 2020

all_facts.Wine description: Truly exceptional wine made by passionate people encapsulates our success story both in New Zealand and around the world. Villa Maria wines are sourced from Auckland, Gisborne, Hawkes Bay and the world-famous Marlborough region, offering incredible diversity in terroir and suitability for different grape varieties. Globally Villa Maria is best known for Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc, however we produce extraordinary Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Pinot Gris, Rosé, Bordeaux style red varietals and Syrah (amongst others) which are all highly awarded and regarded as some of New Zealand’s most iconic fine wines. Villa Maria was the first company in New Zealand to employ professional viticulturists, recognising the part viticulture plays in the quality of the wine. Our vineyard managers understand how to get the best from our vines and soils, and have an in-depth viticulture knowledge of how to make our vineyards robust and resilient – by doing the right things at the right time to ensure the vines are not put under unnecessary stress. The result is consistently superb quality across a range of wines for any occasion.
